findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "resolve_airport" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "resolve_airport" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
